Name: Abandoned Bride - Custom NPC
Author: Brimini
Description:
[font=Tahoma][color=#f4cccc]Warning: [/color]This mod includes mild horror factors. 
[color=#f4cccc]
Supporting Language:[/color] English, Chinese, Korean, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish
[color=#f4cccc]
Compatibility:[/color]
[s]1. Miss Coriel's Unique Courtship Responses IIRC
2. Stardew Valley Expanded SVE 
3. Stardew Valley Reimagined 2 [/s]


One day, you hear a scream of a woman in the deep forest.
Who could it possibly be? What is the hidden story of this wicked girl?
Scare away the summer heat with a breeze of mystery in Stardew Valley!

The unfolding of the Abandoned Bride's story [i]relies heavily on dialogues.[/i]
Listen carefully to find out the secrets of Abandoned Bride.

[color=#f4cccc][i]No spoilers allowed.[/i][/color]

[color=#f4cccc]Relationship matters in this game. [spoiler][/color]Abandoned Bride's likes and dislikes change as you build a relationship with her.
When divorced, her daily dialogues also change. [color=#f4cccc][/spoiler]
[/color][color=#ead1dc]Likes and Dislikes Spoilers [/color][spoiler] ONLY ABANDONED BRIDE'S LIKES AND DISLIKES ([i]not[/i] loves/neutrals/hates) WILL BE TOLD FOR NOW.
Before Seeing Heart 8 Event:
﻿﻿[color=#ead1dc]Loves Clues -[/color][spoiler]What she loves today, is found to be not as interesting in the future.[/spoiler]﻿ ﻿[color=#ead1dc]Likes -[/color] Daffodil, Dandelion, Sweet Pea, Crocus, Holly
﻿[color=#ead1dc]Dislikes -[/color] Sunflower, Tulip Bulb, Prehistoric Rib, Fairy Rose, Blue Jazz, Poppy, Green Tea, Salad, Radish Salad, Fruit Salad[/font][font=Tahoma]
After Seeing Heart 8 Event:
﻿[color=#ead1dc]Loves Clues -[/color][spoiler]As she grows and overcomes her fear, she learns to love something she disliked before.[/spoiler]﻿ ﻿[color=#ead1dc]Likes -[/color] Emerald, Diamond, Aquamarine, Ruby, Topaz, Jade, Amethyst, [/font]Daffodil, Dandelion, Sweet Pea, Crocus, Holly [font=Tahoma]
﻿[color=#ead1dc]Dislikes -[/color] Unspecified[/spoiler]
[color=#f4cccc]If you want the story to progress, talk to Abandoned Bride, increase in hearts, and see events.
[/color]
There are 7 events in total.
[color=#f4cccc]Event Clues[/color] [spoiler]Introduction: None.
Heart 2: Wake up early in the morning before the time calls.
Heart 4: Just like the cursed day.
Heart 6: Oh, what a wonderful afternoon.
Heart 8: None.
Heart 10: Where can I find light in the darkness? Go up.
Heart 14: Where she belongs the most.[/spoiler]
[color=#f4cccc]Event Spoilers[/color] [spoiler]Introduction: Walk into the forest.
Heart 2: Visit her place early in the morning.
Heart 4: Visit her place on a rainy morning.
Heart 6: Visit her place in the afternoon.
Heart 8: Bride will send you a mail for further instructions.
Heart 10: Go to the mountain at night.
Heart 14: Go to the library when Bride is present.[/spoiler]
Inspired by [i]the Great Expectations.[/i]

If there is any error, please let me know.

Thank you to [color=#f4cccc]Lemurkat[/color] who helped me on creating this mod :) [/font]
